name: A retraction notice carries the title of the article it withdraws
name_fr: La notice de rétractation porte le titre de l'article qu'elle annule

origin.campaign: August 2026 — observation campaign, verdicts on scripts and on rare genres (2026-08-08)

seen.observer: house probe (regex, no model), written and run 2026-09-10
seen.excerpt: MEASURED on 2026-09-10 on the 33 retraction notices of the corpus: 25 carry the withdrawn article's title inside their own — « Retraction Note: Delayed administration of pyroglutamate helix B surface peptide… » — and 9 record a disagreement about their own conclusion (« … do not agree with this retraction »). The notice never says WHICH facts fall; it says who no longer trusts them (« The Editor-in-Chief therefore no longer has confidence in the presented data »). An extractor reading the notice therefore produces exactly the fact being withdrawn, with the authors of the withdrawn article under that title.

prevention.refusal_clause: a document whose article-type is a retraction is never read as an assertion of its own title; the withdrawn article is reached through the typed link (Europe PMC exposes pubType 'Retracted Publication' and a typed 'Retraction in' link), never through the text

repair.note: the spurious edge can be deleted once the notice is recognised as a notice; derived from the damage class by the migration of 2026-09-09, not judged form by form and not measured — the bench can measure it

history.event: created from the August 2026 verdicts on scripts and on rare genres, which the atlas had never carried
